mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_NOTICE ( NOTICE_NO , MEMBER_NO , NOTICE_TITLE , NOTICE_CONTENT , IMAGE , CREATED_DATE , COUNT ) VALUES ( SEQ_NOTICE.NEXTVAL , #{memberNo} , #{noticeTitle} , #{noticeContent} , #{image} , SYSDATE , 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT N.NOTICE_NO AS noticeNo , N.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , N.NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle , N.NOTICE_CONTENT AS noticeContent , N.IMAGE , N.CREATED_DATE , N.COUNT , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName FROM TB_NOTICE N LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON (N.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) WHERE N.NOTICE_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY N.NOTICE_NO DESC
